gameDescriptionHtml:
Robots at Midnight is a retro-futuristic Action RPG set on the ruined planet of Yob, a luxury world now left in decay and haunted by the machines once built to serve it.

After twenty years in cryo-sleep, Zoe wakes to find a world she barely recognizes. To survive and to save what’s left, she must track down her missing father, lost during the cataclysmic event known only as The Blackout. Along the way, she’ll take on gangs of corrupted robots, confront towering bosses, and uncover long-buried truths about Yob.

Just be home before midnight.

Game Features

  • Combat with Fluid Movement – Harness the power of your space-gauntlet, The MITT- an old-world tool built for space exploration, now repurposed for survival. Launch off enemies, soar through the air, and smash through bots with momentum-based combat that keeps you constantly in motion. Whether exploring or in the heat of battle, fluid traversal is your greatest weapon. Find your rhythm. Sharpen your skills. Discover what you’re really made of.
  • Choose Your Challenge – Whether you’re new to action RPGs or a seasoned fighter, Robots at Midnight adapts to your playstyle. Hero Mode offers a more forgiving, story-focused experience, while Master Mode brings high-stakes intensity for those seeking a true test of reflexes and strategy. Whichever path you choose, prepare for a fight.
  • Explore and Uncover Hidden Lore – Waking up on a ruined planet is just the beginning. Step into Zoe’s sneakers and investigate the world around you. Discover lost technologies, piece together the story of Yob’s downfall, and decide your place in a future that moved on without you.
